summary: Taylor County tower at CTH M and C in the Town of Browning, built 1960 at 120 feet on private land; DNR announced closure in 2015; listed standing, undated.

facts.design: 120-foot tower (Star News). The 6-by-6-foot cab is a general remark by Schumacher about the spotter job, not tied to this tower

staffing.status: staffed 15 to 20 days each spring; spotting has fallen to two men in recent years

access.note: Stands on land owned by Marvin and Burdella Blumenstein of Rib Lake, per the December 2015 article. Whether the public may approach it is not confirmed.

events.note: Built in 1960 per the Star News. A November 1959 easement from the then owner, Hans Matheus, allowed construction.
Mike Reigert's first climb of the tower in spring 1995; he manned it for about 20 years.
DNR announced a plan in December 2015 to close all remaining fire towers, as reported by the Star News. No Rib River-specific outcome given.

notes_for_editor: The build year, height, cab, staffing and land ownership all come from one 2015 newspaper article; no independent source read. Height 36.6 m converted from 120 ft. The 1959 easement names the then owner as Hans Matheus; the article spells the agency 'DENR' once, which looks like a typo for DNR. Current status after the DNR closure plan is unconfirmed; the FFLA listing is undated. Access is inferred from private ownership as of 2015 and may have changed. Not yet checked: the Wisconsin Historical Society record and any 2016-or-later DNR decision on this tower.
